description: This file defines a PHP class for managing complex numbers, including methods for parsing, formatting, and performing operations on complex numbers.

classes.name: Complex
classes.description: A class representing complex numbers with methods for parsing, formatting, and performing mathematical operations.

methods.name: parseComplex
methods.description: Validates and parses a string or scalar into real, imaginary parts and suffix.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a complex number from real, imaginary parts, or a string.

methods.name: getReal
methods.description: Returns the real part of the complex number.

methods.name: getImaginary
methods.description: Returns the imaginary part of the complex number.

methods.name: getSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix ('i' or 'j') of the complex number.

methods.name: isReal
methods.description: Checks if the complex number is purely real.

methods.name: isComplex
methods.description: Checks if the number has an imaginary component.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the complex number.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the complex number to its string representation.

methods.name: validateComplexArgument
methods.description: Validates and converts an argument into a Complex object.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Returns the complex number with real and imaginary parts swapped.

methods.name: invertImaginary
methods.description: Returns a new complex number with the imaginary part inverted.

methods.name: invertReal
methods.description: Returns a new complex number with the real part inverted.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Dynamically calls a function or operation on the complex number.
